items.title: Is AMD Stock a Buy as AI Revenue Soars?
items.summary: AMD expects its revenue to surge 80% next year.

items.title: Intel Sinks 8% as Midterm Chip Sell-Off Deepens
items.summary: Key TakeawaysIntel fell 8% today as chip stocks sold off on worries that Democrats’ midterm wins could slow the data-center buildout. Intel’s problem is supply: it can’t make enough server chips, so a slower buildout hurts it less than most.

items.title: Intel Stocks Fall 9.1% as Server Demand Meets a Softer Outlook
items.summary: Strong CPU demand sits alongside a lower December-quarter revenue midpoint.

items.title: ASML Sinks 8% as Post-Election Chip Rout Deepens
items.summary: Key TakeawaysASML shares fell 8% today in a post-election chip sell-off, and Everpure fell even harder. ASML had no news, and its customers’ down payments show demand for its machines still outruns supply.

items.title: Why Intel Stock Is Down Today
items.summary: Chip stocks are getting hammered on fears that Democratic control of Congress and key governorships will slow the data center build-out Intel needs.

items.title: Chip Stocks Face AI Regulation Fears
items.summary: Nvidia isn’t the only chipmaker feeling a post-midterms chill.

items.title: Intel Stock Has Plunged 50% in a Month. Trump’s Bad Week Is Getting Worse.
items.summary: The Trump administration's 10% stake in the chip maker has halved in value in just a month.

items.title: What Happens If You Invest $1,000 in AMD And Never Add Another Dollar?
items.summary: AMD shares have swung more than 23% in a single month while sitting on a 127% year-to-date gain, leaving a one-time $1,000 bet pointing in two very different directions depending on which force wins out.
